title: keep-codex-fast: A backup-first Codex skill for keeping local Codex state fast and recoverable

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: The longer you use codecs, the more clogged the workspace gets. Context bloat, agent slows down. Nuke.codex to speed things up, and your agent gets instant amnesia. Keep Codex fast as a backup first skill. Before wiping redundant files or archiving old chat logs, it generates a handover document summarizing your architectural context and active tasks. then hands that compressed memory back to the freshly cleaned agent.
